derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4245 (πρεσβύτερος);
def: the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery"

occurrences.text: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
